title: Vancouver Jetski Tour with Dinner on Bowen Island
includes: Jetski, lifejacket and safety equipment. Optional wetsuit
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Anyone over 19 can drive with a valid government issued photo ID
Anyone 16-18 must present a valid Driver's license to drive, and must also be accompanied by an adult (same or separate machine).
You will only be able to get a beer or wine if you are over 19 years old. You will have the option of a fresh juice, smoothie, ice cream or coffee if underage.
policies: There is a $12 collision coverage fee and a $1,000 damage deductible, collected during check-in. The dedutible is released at the end of the activity
Operates in all weather conditions; please dress appropriately. Wetsuits are provided and swimsuits recommended. Jeans are not accepted on the jetskis
You do not need a boaters license to rent or operate Jetski. We supply the boaters license and training course (check-in 1 hour before departure)
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Hit the throttle of a Sea-Doo watercraft out of English Bay, explore Howe Sound and then head to dinner at a local restaurant on Bowen Island. We invite you to stroll through the shops before we jump back in the boat to do more exploring. This guided evening Jetski tour from Granville Island includes wildlife sightseeing beforehand: think a large seal colony at Pam Rocks and migratory birds swooping overhead.
